# Vintage Vogue India — Complete Knowledge Base & Specimen Dossier

## 1. Brand Overview & Curatorial Philosophy
Vintage Vogue India (@vintagevoguee_in) is an archival fashion house and curated thrift flagship studio based in Kota, Rajasthan, India. Specializing in rare Japanese workwear, American heritage denim, distressed flight leather bombers, and vintage western wear, Vintage Vogue curates 1-of-1 archival specimens sourced directly from vintage flea markets in Shimokitazawa (Tokyo), Nagoya, Osaka, Paris, and the American Midwest.

Every piece is verified for authentic textile weave, historical hardware (Talon, Scovill, YKK Japan, brass shanks), single-stitch constructions, and natural patina. To ensure hospital-grade hygiene, every garment undergoes deep organic eucalyptus mist sanitization and dry steam sterilization in our Kota workshop before being cataloged with flat-laid tape dimensions down to the quarter-inch.

- **Appointments**: In-person curatorial fitting consultations available by prior appointment
- **Direct Concierge**: +91 98290 12345 (Voice & WhatsApp)

## 3. Shipping & Pan-India Dispatch Operations
All online and remote concierge orders are dispatched within 24 hours directly from our Kota Hub via Blue Dart Express Airway service:
- **Rajasthan, NCR, Delhi**: 24 to 48 hours delivery window
- **Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata**: 2 to 3 days delivery window
- **Rest of India & Tier-2 Hubs**: 3 to 4 days delivery window
- **Free Air Shipping**: Automatically applied to all orders above ₹2,999 INR
- **Packaging**: Unbleached archival tissue wrapping, custom kraft mailer box, and signature Crimson Vintage Vogue wax seal stamp (VV 1992 SEALED)

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Are items returnable?** Due to the strict 1-of-1 archival nature of each specimen, all acquisitions are final once dispatched. We provide complete tape measurements to guarantee an exact fit prior to purchase.
- **Can I pay via UPI?** Yes, Bharat UPI is our primary instant settlement mode supporting Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, and BHIM with zero processing fees.
- **Is Cash on Delivery available?** Yes, Cash on Delivery is available across all serviceable Indian pincodes via Blue Dart Express.
